mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 28 degrees with clear skies around Harriet Park. We have a clear view for the International Space Station tonight, which will rise in the West over Mount Horeb at 6:32 PM, traveling toward Madison and reaching about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects including plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, while the Municipal Court reminds residents that tickets can be paid online if a mandatory appearance is not required.

Today features the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company or the John Denver tribute concert at the High School.
In a report from October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were contacted by officers for riding prohibited e-Motos, resulting in citations issued to their parents.
Stop by Culver's when the doors open today at 10:00 AM to enjoy the Caramel Cashew flavor of the day.
